Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Adults patients ≥ 18 years of age  [AND] with CD  [AND] with at least colonic involvement, [OR]  UC, [OR]  or non-IBD  [AND] controls who have been referred for colonoscopy for clinical reasons

right.raw_text: The clinical reasons may include colorectal cancer screening, [OR]  surveillance, diagnostic for CD  [OR] or UC  [OR] flare, or gastrointestinal symptoms

left.raw_text: -  Patients with known current colorectal cancer, [OR]  infectious colitis, [OR]  diverticulitis, [OR]  or microscopic colitis

right.raw_text: -  Patients who have undergone surgery involving the cecum  [OR] or rectum
